## New defect F-29: React error #418 for English users

Every server-rendered page logs `Minified React error #418 (args: text)` when the visitor chose English. Reproduced from the session with Playwright on `/auth`, `/` and an unknown path: with `mychata.lang = en` in localStorage one #418 per load; with Czech none. Cause: `LanguageProvider` read localStorage in its first render, so the hydration render was English while the server's HTML is Czech; React then discards the server HTML and renders the whole page again on the client. Fixed in T-048 (`useSyncExternalStore` with the server's "cs" as the hydration snapshot). Verified on a local production build served by wrangler: old code one #418 per load, new code none, page ends in English with `lang="en"` and the English title, and switching to CZ works.

While the desktop app's window is in the background, pointer clicks from the session didn't reach the page (refs and coordinates); script clicks did. Screenshots came back blank in the same state. Not a site issue.
